annotations.title: Mark an incident resolved by hand

description: Mark a firing incident resolved now, with a required reason, when you have fixed it and the source has not caught up (a push source repeats only every few hours). It leaves the wall, History records "marked resolved by <you>" with your reason, and the operator log records the write. It does not hide a live problem: if the source reports the alert as firing on its next poll or push, Watch reopens the incident as a NEW firing (unacknowledged, escalating, paging again) and records "reopened: source still firing after manual resolve by <you>". A manual resolve ends any acknowledgement or silence on the incident. You can never resolve, delete or edit an alert itself: only its source resolves alerts. After the source resolves, use confirm_resolution to record that you checked.

by.description: Who is doing this, as "agent: <who>", for example "agent: claude in web-app". Required: it is shown on the tile, in the incident sheet and in History. "agent: " is added when left off. At most 64 characters.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.

reason.description: Why it is resolved: what you changed and how you know, at most 500 characters. Required.

name: resolve
title: Mark an incident resolved by hand
